_doc: The informal-obligations layer (world v128) — 'the counter tab.' Per-door-venue registry of the arrangements that run on memory, not invoices: spare keys held, shifts covered, running tabs, standing holds, lent equipment, watched mail, passed culls, favors owed. Companion spec: world/favors.md. Demo: world/favor.html (inline FAV mirror, hand-synced, deep-compared by audit.js favs gate). Consumers: the brain/prompt layer (counter-side texture — who can ask what of whom), the feed layer (an honored or dropped arrangement is a readable beat, never a summoned one). Rules: doors only (anchor + street); every arrangement names who CARRIES the standing cost; visibility is open / counter / quiet — quiet rows redact on public clearance like secret web edges; no credit figures, no USD, balances are game dollars; conditions, never scripts — an arrangement is a standing invitation someone may honor, renegotiate, or let lapse, and the lapse is the content.

kind_keys.key_holding: one party keeps another's spare key or alarm code — trust made physical
kind_keys.shift_cover: an informal cover arrangement — the call when someone is short-handed
kind_keys.tab_line: a running informal tab in game dollars, settled by a house rule, not an invoice
kind_keys.lend: equipment or space lent on a standing basis — the thing lives in two places
kind_keys.hold: a standing hold — the chair, the crate, the table — kept without being asked
kind_keys.watch: mail, packages, plants, or a door watched during absence or overlap
kind_keys.pass: culls, day-olds, scraps, or leftovers passed on a standing basis
kind_keys.favor_owed: a named past kindness carried as an open obligation — the ledger nobody wrote down

visibility_keys.open: readable from the room — a regular would know
visibility_keys.counter: the staff side carries it; a customer would not
visibility_keys.quiet: between the parties only — redacted on public clearance

party_forms.venue: a business id from businesses.json — the house itself
party_forms.person: a cast id (c1–c8), supporting id (s1–s3), or ambient id (a01–a20) — the obligation attaches to the person, not the role
party_forms.staff: the literal token 'staff' may appear in `carries` only — the keyed venue collectively bears it

mudhaus.terms: the hemming tab — Carmen runs it all week, settles Fridays in cash counted twice
mudhaus.note: nobody writes it down anymore; the float risk is the house's

mudhaus.terms: rain on the bench means the corner two-top is Esther's — held unmarked, no purchase clock
mudhaus.note: a table the house keeps ready on bad-weather mornings; some days it just stays empty

mudhaus.since: the pastry case got too full, 2024
mudhaus.terms: the day-old crate goes to whoever Tomás sends after close — staff meal, not trash
mudhaus.note: the crate sits by the back door from 18:30; an untouched crate at open is a readable anomaly

mudhaus.terms: six folding chairs and the good extension cord live at the Workers' Table Thursdays, back by Friday open
mudhaus.note: the cord comes back taped a little differently each time; nobody re-tapes it

el-farolote.terms: Marcus eats after the last run; the ticket settles when the week's deliveries do
el-farolote.note: the post-1 AM burrito is half wage, half weather report — he hears the night first

el-farolote.terms: a short-handed line can call the other kitchen — one cook, one shift, repaid in kind not cash
el-farolote.note: nobody counts the balance precisely; both kitchens keep rough track and prefer it that way

el-farolote.terms: Gus ran a compressor part across town at 23:00; his crew's Friday lunch has been on the house tab ever since
el-farolote.note: Gus keeps trying to pay; the register keeps not ringing — the debt is being repaid weekly and he knows it

auerbach.terms: each shop holds the other's storefront key in the back drawer — one call, no locksmith, no questions
auerbach.note: used maybe twice a year; both drawers stay unlocked precisely because this exists

auerbach.terms: the hand truck lives in whichever shop used it last — it walks Valencia twice a month
auerbach.note: neither shop owns it on paper anymore; both charge it out to customers anyway

auerbach.since: Clarion alley got too crowded for deliveries, 2024
auerbach.terms: Needlepointe's oversize packages land at the hardware counter; Bex collects them on the smoke-break loop
auerbach.note: Victor's counter is the de facto loading dock for a shop with no dock

dolores-perk.terms: the hook rail by the door is the dog-walker's — Doro's pack ties off there, no cup required
dolores-perk.note: six leashes at 8 AM is a normal morning; a bare rail means Doro's route changed

dolores-perk.terms: the creamery's overrun slept in the Perk's freezer for five nights; the Perk's park-side tables still absorb the line, no vouchers needed
dolores-perk.note: the debt is the arrangement — both sides stopped counting and kept the habit

buy-rite-market.terms: Ray's groceries ride the last week of the month; the counter settles it on the first, no list kept
buy-rite-market.note: the cashier writes nothing down — Ray's basket is that regular

buy-rite-market.terms: Luz's crate deliveries land on the Buy-Rite dock when the stand is closed; she collects before her morning setup
buy-rite-market.note: a rival's dock is still a dock — the fruit doesn't care about the edge

buy-rite-creamery.terms: the corner booth has the outlet — Zee's phone charges there, one scoop is optional
buy-rite-creamery.note: the staff stopped pretending it's about the ice cream; the booth is the point

buy-rite-creamery.since: a nurse asked for the almost-melted pint, 2024
buy-rite-creamery.terms: the last scooped-dry tub of the night goes to whoever's coming off shift — Asha knows the freezer door code is a fiction
buy-rite-creamery.note: a tub set aside on the back shelf is a message; an empty shelf means the night was clean

il-delfino.terms: Marcus's courier bags rest warm by the pass when a run lands late — the food waits, not the rider
il-delfino.note: the date-night room never sees the courier; the pass shelf is the whole arrangement

il-delfino.terms: date-night rivals cover each other's line — one cook, one shift, repaid in kind
il-delfino.note: the rivalry is for the floor; the pass is where the actual kitchens live

baguette-about-it.terms: two morning buns stay back for the Mudhaus openers before the doors unlock — the restock eats first
baguette-about-it.note: Hana sets them aside without being asked; a missing pair means the bake ran short

baguette-about-it.terms: Ida holds the bakery's alarm key — a baker who can't get in at four is a block without bread
baguette-about-it.note: the key has been used once; it stays because four in the morning is not a locksmith hour

the-600-club.terms: the back booth is Bex's on the nights her portfolio goes around — kept dark until she shows or doesn't
the-600-club.note: a booth that stays empty through happy hour is the bar keeping a promise

the-600-club.terms: Sam's amp sleeps in the back room between gig nights — the bar's storage is the busker's locker
the-600-club.note: the corner spot stays loud partly because the gear never has to walk home

dandy-lion.terms: broken truffles go to Ida's back counter; stem scraps come back as arrangement garnish
dandy-lion.note: the trade is visible in both windows — petals dusted, truffles mended into staff snacks

dandy-lion.terms: the window table is June's during finals — one hot chocolate, three hours, no side-eye
dandy-lion.note: the shop loses a table twice a year and gains a graduate who buys gift boxes forever

valencia-growers.terms: Tomás's tomato case is set aside before the stalls open — he walks, compares, and still buys it
valencia-growers.note: the ritual is the point: the held case is an offer, not a sale, and he compares anyway

valencia-growers.since: the year the card reader died, 2022
valencia-growers.terms: Luz covered a stall fee in cash when the readers failed; the stall hasn't forgotten
valencia-growers.note: nobody settled it because settling it would end it — the stand gets first pick of the cull crates

needlepointe.since: the night the manager locked himself out, 2023
needlepointe.terms: Bex holds the bar's spare front key in the shop's lockbox — the tattoo shop is the bar's spare pocket
needlepointe.note: a 2 AM key run is the worst version of this arrangement and it has happened twice

needlepointe.terms: the flash-frame projector lives at Marooned on show nights — the shop's wall goes dark so the records light up
needlepointe.note: the projector walks Valencia in a milk crate; it has never once been signed out

folsom-auto.terms: Victor's counter stock rides the shop account — parts settled monthly, fittings settled in walks
folsom-auto.note: the ledger is a greasy index card; the mid-job walks are the interest

folsom-auto.terms: Omar's bike takes the open lift ahead of paying jobs — a courier without wheels has no week
folsom-auto.note: a paying car waits an hour so a rider doesn't lose a day; the shop eats the schedule

maliks.terms: Cole's crew runs a morning float — coffee and rolls on the card, settled Friday envelope
maliks.note: the envelope is exact to the quarter; the tab exists so 6:45 AM never involves counting

maliks.terms: Malik signs for the laundromat's vending deliveries when nobody's at the folding tables
maliks.note: the signature is always 'M.' — the distributor stopped asking years ago

las-palmas.terms: Ida's buckets get Luz's stem culls; the stand gets a bouquet for the scale when the culls run good
las-palmas.note: the corner smells like both by noon because the trade is literally in the air

las-palmas.terms: the two best avocados of the day wait under the counter on Esther's mornings — she never asks, they're never sold
las-palmas.note: an arrangement kept by a fruit stand is still an arrangement — the held pair is the contract

bloom-and-doom.terms: Ida's bud vases dress the Musket's tables Fridays and walk back Sunday — the dining room borrows a garden
bloom-and-doom.note: twenty-two vases, counted at both ends; the count is the friendship

bloom-and-doom.since: a nurse stopped to smell the culls, 2024
bloom-and-doom.terms: the day-old bouquet bucket goes to the ward break room — Asha carries it on the walk she was already taking
bloom-and-doom.note: a bucket that leaves the shop at shift change is flowers doing their second job

golden-hour.terms: the corner folding table is Ray's when it rains — pigeons or no pigeons, the chair knows him
golden-hour.note: a laundromat has no business holding a chair for a man who never washes there; it does anyway

golden-hour.terms: two folding tables leave Thursday afternoon for the Workers' Table and come back Thursday night
golden-hour.note: the laundromat's tables have a second shift nobody scheduled

dusty-spine.terms: Jules's hold stack lives under the counter — books pulled on sight, claimed when the shift money lands
dusty-spine.note: the stack sometimes outlasts the wanting; it gets reshelved unresentfully

dusty-spine.since: the twenty-dollar loop got a pastry, 2023
dusty-spine.terms: whoever opens first brings the morning bun for both counters — the loop has a breakfast
dusty-spine.note: the bun appears on one counter or the other every morning; nobody remembers whose turn it is and that's the arrangement

marooned.terms: Sam's records crate lives behind the counter between corner sets — a busker's inventory is a shop's shelf
marooned.note: the crate never leaves the block; it just changes which counter it sleeps behind

marooned.terms: the Dusty Spine's upstairs took Marooned's stock the night Valencia flooded — the bins remember the stairs
marooned.note: repaid in first refusal on every good trade-in since; both shops prefer it unspoken

the-musket.terms: the kitchen sends one plate downhill to whoever's closing the bar — staff meal, delivered, never ordered
the-musket.note: a plate walks the block at 23:00 most nights; the bartender's shift ends fed

the-musket.terms: Dani redraws the menu board when the seasons change; the running dinner tab is the payment
the-musket.note: the tab is the invoice and the friendship at once — nobody's sure which side is ahead
